title: floating-credit-pools-with-usage-triggered-educational-upgrades
creator: Ariana Patel
description:
Summary: Run a controlled experiment that replaces a single fixed free-credit grant with a small floating credit pool that refreshes on behavior (feature-triggered), plus contextual in-product educational upgrade prompts. Goal: increase PLG conversion efficiency by aligning free usage to valuable product behaviors while reducing wasted token giveaways.

Hypothesis: If we provide a small renewable credit balance that replenishes only when a user performs high-signal actions (e.g., deploys a model route, creates a dedicated key, or runs an evaluation suite) and surface contextual guidance on upgrade paths, then trial-to-paid conversion rate will increase by 20% for engaged cohorts while overall free-credit leakage will fall by 25%.

Experiment design: A/B test across new self-serve signups for 8 weeks. Control = current one-time 5k free credits with 30d expiry. Variant A = floating pool of 2k credits initial + 1k refresh on specified high-signal event; refreshes up to 3x; each credit tranche expires 14d after issuance. Variant B = same as A but with contextual in-product education (microcopy + CTA to pricing) shown on the first two refresh events.

Segmentation: New signups only. Stratify by org size (single-user vs team) and by acquisition channel (OSS vs direct). Exclude existing enterprise/paid accounts. Metric windows: 14d activation window and 60d conversion window.

Primary metrics: 
- Conversion to paid within 60d (primary lift metric)
- Paid MRR per converted org (quality filter)
- Free-credit leakage (unused credits that expire)
Secondary metrics: 
- Activation rate (key creation, first API call) within 14d
- Average tokens consumed per user
- Support contact volume about billing/credits

Success criteria: >= 15% relative lift in 60d conversion for Variant B vs control AND no more than 10% increase in support billing questions. Secondary pass if Variant A shows improved leakage but smaller conversion lift; iterate copy.

Implementation notes: 
- Backend: billing service needs support for time-bound credit tranches and event-triggered issuances (ENG-4212).
- Console: UI for credit balance with time-to-expiry and refresh history; small banner plus inline microcopy for Variant B (ENG-5088).
- Growth: experiment hooks for A/B assignment and instrumentation to fire cohort tags.
- Legal/Compliance: update security questionnaire language to document credit expiry behavior and data retention implications for trial telemetry (see Security To-Do).

Risk & mitigations: 
- Risk: Users may find rolling credits confusing -> mitigation: show clear countdown and tooltip explaining refresh rules; run micro-interviews post-experiment.
- Risk: Increased support load -> mitigation: add a billing FAQ and canned responses for CS.
- Risk: Abuse by scripted refreshes -> mitigation: throttle refreshes per org and detect anomalous patterns.

Data tracking & dashboards: Looker dashboard board: /dashboards/plg/credit-pools-experiment (placeholder link). Events: credit_issued, credit_expired, credit_refreshed, conversion_paid. Instrumentation spec in PRD (link below).

Artifacts:

- Mockups: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/floating-credit-pools (variant screens)
- Growth plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/placeholder-growth-plan
